notes.title: IndieX Online 2022 Finalist Little Orpheus Developer Livestream
notes.content:
Hey there gamers,
We’re very pleased to announce that [i]Little Orpheus[/i] is a finalist in this year’s IndieX 2022 Online Edition gaming awards. To celebrate the event, two of the team will be taking part in a special livestream on November 8th at 12:00 GMT to discuss the game’s development.  Join lead artis Laura Dodds and lead level designer Will Traynor over on Twitch to get a real insight into the development of Little Orpheus.

Watch the stream here: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rtparena]https://www.twitch.tv/rtparena[/url] or here: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rubberchickentv]https://www.twitch.tv/rubberchickentv[/url]

[b]What is IndieX?[/b]
Indie X is Portugal’s biggest indie game showcase featuring both national and international indie games with the aim to promote the best games that Portugal’s rising game dev industry has to offer, as well as a selection of international indies who tag along for an awesome showcase.

notes.title: Little Orpheus now available to explore!
notes.content:
Hello cosmonauts,
It brings us immense joy to announce that [i]Little Orpheus[/i], the award-winning narrative side-scrolling adventure from the master storytellers at The Chinese Room, is now available.

The year is 1962 and NASA is trying to put a man on the moon. In a remote corner of Siberia, a Soviet cosmonaut is heading in the other direction. Ivan Ivanovich is dropped into an extinct volcano in his exploration capsule, [i]Little Orpheus[/i], to explore the centre of the Earth. He promptly vanishes. Three years later he emerges claiming to have saved the world. 
 
Join Ivan as he explores lost civilizations, undersea kingdoms, prehistoric jungles and lands beyond imagination. [i]Little Orpheus[/i] is a fantastical side-scrolling adventure game for casual players and seasoned adventure fans alike, inspired by classic movies such as [i]Flash Gordon[/i], [i]Sinbad [/i]and [i]The Land that Time Forgot[/i].

[previewyoutube=VWwJgq7P3Uk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Game Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] A stunning, colourful world remastered for PC with hi-res textures, new moves and animations, enhanced graphics and lighting effects.
[*] A gripping story full of humour and adventure by the award-winning masters at The Chinese Room, creators of Dear Esther and Everybody’s Gone to the Rapture.
[*] Award-winning vocal performances and a world-class music score by BAFTA-winning composer Jessica Curry and Jim Fowler, enhanced for PC in 5.1 surround sound.
[*] Includes the bonus 9th episode A Rush of Onion to the Head and the Lost Recordings Mode.
[/list]
Suit-up and join us on this once in a lifetime journey.

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558930/Little_Orpheus/]Download Little Orpheus TODAY![/url] [/h2]

notes.title: Little Orpheus is landing on September 13th
notes.content:
...Incoming Cosmonaut transmission...

Hey there!

Things have been a bit quiet around here of late but we're very excited to inform you that The Chinese Room's [i]Little Orpheus[/i] is landing on September 13th.

Following the delay earlier this year, The Chinese Room and us here at Secret Mode carefully evaluated the content within [i]Little Orpheus[/i] considering wider world events. We are confident that the game does not contain material that could offend or harm and that [i]Little Orpheus[/i] can release without any changes to its content. 

[i]Little Orpheus[/i] is a fantastical journey set in 1962, inspired by classic adventure stories such as Journey to the Centre of the Earth, Flash Gordon, and The Land That Time Forgot. 

[previewyoutube=9tTJhFVE43k;full][/previewyoutube]

This definitive edition of the multi-award-winning Apple Arcade hit from master storytellers The Chinese Room is rebuilt and remastered for the big screen with hi-res textures, new animations, and enhanced graphics and effects. [i]Little Orpheus[/i] for PC also features the bonus ninth episode - [i]A Rush of Onion to the Head[/i] - and the Lost Recordings Mode from the original release.  

We look forward to you joining us in this adventure as we return to the past and cast our eyes downwards in search of fresh wonders lying beneath our feet.

Thanks for your continued patience and support,
Team Secret Mode

notes.title: Sidescrolling lost-world adventure Little Orpheus finally lands on PC in September
notes.content:
Dear Esther and Everybody’s Gone To The Rapture devs The Chinese Room are bringing their postponed cosmonaut adventure Little Orpheus to PC on September 13th. The game had originally been due to launch on March 1st but was delayed. Little Orpheus stars a Soviet Russian character, and the devs wanted to review its content before release out of sensitivity to the conflict in Ukraine. Check out the trailer below.

Read more

notes.title: Little Orpheus delayed 'in light of recent world events'
notes.content:
Publishers Secret Mode have announced that they won't be releasing action adventure game Little Orpheus for PC today, as previously planned. The game features a Soviet cosmonaut, which Secret Mode wrote "may be upsetting to players at this time."

Read more

notes.title: Important announcement regarding the release of Little Orpheus
notes.content:
In light of recent world events, today's launch for Little Orpheus will be delayed.

Little Orpheus is a fantastical journey set in 1962, inspired by classic adventure stories such as Journey to the Centre of the Earth, Flash Gordon, and The Land That Time Forgot. It is a tale about an intrepid cosmonaut and the triumph of the human spirit against incredible odds. 

While Little Orpheus was originally released on Apple Arcade in June 2020 and does not directly reference recent world events, we recognise some of the game's themes and content may be upsetting to players at this time.

We thank you for your understanding and will share more information at a later point.
